newsitem.title: TUNISIA: Tunisia Le Moteur takes Tunis bourse down.
newsitem.headline: Tunisia Le Moteur takes Tunis bourse down.

text.p: The Tunis Stock Exchange index on Tuesday closed down by 1.06 percent driven by Tunisian company Le Moteur in lower trade, bourse sources said.
The 31-share index closed at 465.59 points, down from 470.56 on Monday.
Total volume was 3.38 million dinars against 6.39 million dinars over the previous session. Over-the-counter exchanges and turnover on the occasional market amounted to three million dinars.
Tunisian company Le Moteur dropped 5.64 dinars to 28.36 dinars on the exchange of 42 shares.
UBCI bank fell 2.08 dinars to 42.72 dinars.
Investment fund SPDIT-SICAF slid 0.93 dinar to 14.59.

Banque Nationale Agricole was down 0.75 dinar to 24.24 dinars with 2,200 shares changing hands. Banque du Sud eased 0.72 dinar to 23.37. Banque du Sud announced on Monday that its net profits in 1996 amounted to 10.3 million dinars compared to 9.7 million dinars in 1995.
Airline Tunis Air was down 0.66 dinar to 22.84 dinars with the exchange of 2,583 shares.
Banque Internationale Arabe de Tunisie declined 0.58 dinar to 30.92. Banque de l'Habitat edged lower 0.45 dinar to 14.61 dinars. ($1=1.0994 dinar)
